edge_sample.target_text: definition Markov kernel: {} Let $(X,\mathcal X)$ and $(Y,\mathcal{Y})$ be measurable spaces. We say that $\pi\in\text{Ker}_{\mathcal{Y},\mathcal X}$ is a \textbf{Markov kernel} iff $\pi(X\mid \cdot)=1$.

edge_sample.source_text: definition Conditional expectation kernel: {} Let $\mu\in\mathfrak{M}(X,\mathcal X)$. Then, $\pi\in\text{Ker}_{\mathcal B,\mathcal X}$ is a \textbf{conditional expectation kernel for $\mu$} if $\mu(A\mid \mathcal B)=\pi(A\mid\cdot)$ $\mu$-a.e.

edge_sample.target_text: definition Proper specification: {} A specification $\gamma$ is \textbf{proper} iff the kernel $\gamma_\Lambda$ is proper for every $\Lambda \in \mathrm{Finset}(S)$.

edge_sample.source_text: definition Proper kernel: {} $\pi$ is \textbf{proper} iff $\pi(A\cap B\mid x)=\pi(A\mid x)\cdot\mathbf{1}_B(x)$ for all $A\in\mathcal X$, $B\in\mathcal B$ and $x\in X$.

edge_sample.target_text: lemma A modifier of a proper specification is proper: {} If $\gamma$ is a specification and $\rho$ a modifier of $\gamma$, then $\rho\gamma$ is a proper specification.

edge_sample.source_text: lemma ISSSDs are proper specifications: $\mathrm{ISSSD}(\nu)$ is a proper specification.
